step: filter and diafilter, or ion exchange
text: Isolate is made from defatted, clarified whey, not from finished concentrate: ultrafiltration and diafiltration (often after microfiltration) wash out lactose and minerals, or ion exchange binds the protein and releases it again. Skim milk can also be microfiltered to give native whey, which is then ultrafiltered.
